Shape.ThreeD.PresetMaterial accepts ordinal values 1..15, but the eighth native material warmMatte is saved by PowerPoint without a prstMaterial attribute; all other native material tokens are retained. Native warmMatte remains serializer-supported and is not falsely classified as absent.

PowerPoint Shape.ThreeD exposes no writable independent position-Z or camera-Z endpoint, and DrawingML a:camera/a:sp3d contains no position-Z attribute. Use camera preset, fieldOfView/perspective, rotations, extrusion depth, or model3D camera controls for their respective semantics; do not invent pictureStyle.threeD.position.z.
